description: S458 slice 2: a NESTED function's refined parameter is checked. `pick(u: string(url))` is declared inside `show`; called with "javascript:alert(1)" its entry check throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT, so @shown keeps the https value from the first click. Before S458 only the top-level client function emitter wrote a parameter check; a nested function (and worker / tool / library functions) got none.
rationale: §53.9.1: "The compiler SHALL emit a runtime check when the function is called with an unconstrained argument" — no carve-out for nested functions.
